name: Rising Star Championship
epitaph: Eric Scott became the first Rising Star Champion at Fusion 1.2 on 20 October 2002, submitting Marcus Christian with the All-Star Leglock in a three-way that also carried Jerome Marko, then retained the title at Fusion 1.5 on 20 November 2002 by forcing Jesse Ewiak's submission.

name: Wildside Championship
epitaph: Neige Thirteen became the first Wildside Champion at Fusion 1.2 on 20 October 2002, pinning Jaime Roberts in a three-way that also carried Rick Hanson.

name: WILD World Championship
epitaph: Spikyjim became the first WILD World Champion at Fusion 1.2 on 20 October 2002, pinning Eddie Drysdale in a three-way that also carried his own tag partner, Travis Lagrange.
